course_description: Abstract data types, linear and non-linear data structures including stacks, queues, linked lists, binary search trees, heaps, hash tables, and asymptotic Big-O algorithmic complexity analysis.

course_outcomes.co_description: Implement linear data structures including arrays, linked lists, stacks, and queues to solve computing problems.
Analyze the time and space complexity of iterative and recursive algorithms using asymptotic Big-O notation.
Construct non-linear hierarchical data structures such as binary search trees, AVL trees, heaps, and graphs.
Evaluate collision resolution techniques in hash tables and compare shortest path graph traversal algorithms.
Design and synthesize optimized software modules integrating compound data structures for complex systems.

weekly_schedule.topic: Course Orientation & Review of Pointers and Memory Allocation
weekly_schedule.teaching_learning_activity: Interactive Lecture & IDE Memory Debugging Lab

lesson_outcomes.description: Explain memory allocation fundamentals in heap and stack memory
Write pointer manipulation functions without memory leaks
Acknowledge software engineering discipline and academic integrity

weekly_schedule.topic: Abstract Data Types (ADTs) and Dynamic Array Implementations

lesson_outcomes.description: Define abstract data types versus concrete data structures
Implement dynamic resizing arrays with amortization
Appreciate memory efficiency and bounds checking

weekly_schedule.topic: Singly and Doubly Linked Lists: Insertion, Traversal, and Deletion
weekly_schedule.teaching_learning_activity: Hands-on Linked List Pointer Linking Lab

lesson_outcomes.description: Describe node linking mechanics and memory pointer updates
Code insertion, traversal, and deletion in linked lists
Demonstrate patience when debugging null pointer dereferences

weekly_schedule.topic: Stack Data Structures: LIFO Mechanics and Expression Parsing

lesson_outcomes.description: Explain LIFO operations and call stack mechanisms
Implement stack operations and expression conversion algorithms
Value clean modularization in data structure interfaces

weekly_schedule.topic: Queue Data Structures: FIFO Mechanics, Circular Queues, and Deques

lesson_outcomes.description: Differentiate linear queues from circular buffer queues
Construct circular queue arrays and linked queue variants
Display diligence in handling queue overflow and underflow

weekly_schedule.topic: Preliminary Examination: Linear Data Structures Theory and Practical Coding Exam

lesson_outcomes.description: Recall fundamental linear ADTs and algorithm definitions
Implement timed linear data structure operations under exam conditions
Exhibit academic integrity and professional composure

weekly_schedule.topic: Algorithm Analysis: Big-O, Big-Omega, and Big-Theta Notations

lesson_outcomes.description: Formulate mathematical equations for asymptotic Big-O bounds
Profile runtime performance across differing input scales
Embrace mathematical rigor in performance evaluations

weekly_schedule.topic: Recursion Fundamentals, Recurrence Relations, and Master Theorem

lesson_outcomes.description: Explain divide-and-conquer paradigms and recurrence relations
Write recursive algorithms with robust base termination conditions
Value conceptual elegance in recursive logic

weekly_schedule.topic: Elementary Sorting (Bubble, Insertion, Selection) vs Advanced Sorting (Merge, Quick)

lesson_outcomes.description: Analyze average and worst-case complexities of comparison sorts
Implement in-place quicksort and stable mergesort routines
Appreciate algorithmic efficiency in data organization

weekly_schedule.topic: Binary Trees and Binary Search Trees (BST): Traversals and Search

lesson_outcomes.description: Identify tree terminology (height, depth, internal nodes)
Code preorder, inorder, and postorder tree traversal functions
Display curiosity when exploring tree balancing concepts

weekly_schedule.topic: Self-Balancing Trees: AVL Trees and Rotations

lesson_outcomes.description: Explain balance factors and tree rotation types (LL, RR, LR, RL)
Implement height-balanced node rotations in AVL trees
Value mathematical equilibrium in data preservation

weekly_schedule.topic: Midterm Examination: Tree Structures and Algorithm Analysis Practical Exam

lesson_outcomes.description: Synthesize asymptotic analysis and hierarchical tree concepts
Execute live balanced tree insertion and deletion algorithms
Demonstrate technical mastery under formal timed evaluation

weekly_schedule.topic: Priority Queues and Binary Heaps: Min-Heap and Max-Heap Operations
weekly_schedule.teaching_learning_activity: Heapify and Priority Queue Coding Lab

lesson_outcomes.description: Describe complete binary tree properties and array heap representations
Implement heapify-up and heapify-down priority queue operations
Value algorithmic precision in priority scheduling

weekly_schedule.topic: Hash Tables, Hash Functions, and Collision Resolution (Chaining vs Open Addressing)
weekly_schedule.teaching_learning_activity: Hash Map Coding and Collision Profiling

lesson_outcomes.description: Explain hash distributions, load factors, and collision handling
Construct hash tables with linear probing and chaining
Diligently assess security and distribution of hash algorithms

weekly_schedule.topic: Graph Theory: Adjacency Matrices, Adjacency Lists, and Graph Traversals (BFS & DFS)

lesson_outcomes.description: Define vertices, directed/undirected edges, and weighted graphs
Program Breadth-First Search (BFS) and Depth-First Search (DFS)
Foster logical thinking in complex network modelling

weekly_schedule.topic: Shortest Paths & Minimum Spanning Trees: Dijkstra’s and Kruskal’s Algorithms

lesson_outcomes.description: Analyze greedy algorithmic strategies for graphs
Implement Dijkstra’s shortest path algorithm using priority queues
Strive for excellence in route optimization solutions

weekly_schedule.topic: Comprehensive Project Integration and Compound Data Structure Architecture

lesson_outcomes.description: Structure compound data structures for multi-layered computing problems
Collaborate on complex codebase integration and unit testing
Practice constructive peer critique and collaborative teamwork

weekly_schedule.topic: Final Examination & Capstone Defense: Data Structures Engine Evaluation

lesson_outcomes.description: Synthesize all linear and non-linear data structures paradigms
Present and defend functional enterprise data structure solution
Demonstrate Perpetualite professional ethics and leadership
